lines.ruling: Ruling: model error and interface gap; i1040gi p. 19, Step 4, "Any other person (other than your spouse) who lived with you all year as a member of your household if your relationship didn't violate local law". The reply tests dependent.lawful for every person it reaches as a member of the household. The project asks that question only of a sibling's descendant or another person (dependent.qr_other_relation); for the relationship answer household_member, whose wording carries the local-law condition, it tests dependent.qr_all_year alone (dependent.qr_household_member). On the 3 completed value witnesses (stage8.single.dependent.household_and_ssn, f1.t153.friend_child_nontaxpayer and t091r.absence.household_member_not_test2: project true, reply false; the first traced) the entry is a household_member, the fixture states no dependent.lawful answer, the test-data default supplies false, and the reply's qualifying-relative test fails on it. They are the witnesses of the earlier rulings on this line. The reply also asks dependent.multiple_support of every entry and refuses on it, the qualifying-relative screen on a qualifying child that the earlier rulings on this line found in earlier replies (i1040gi p. 21, Multiple support agreements; p. 17, Step 1). Re-reviewed whole (dependent has partial-input cases) because f2441.care and f2441.nondependent, which dependent.dc_qp and lines 2(c) and 2(d) read, were reworded to the one spouse phrase; this round changes no project expression and no wording of this form. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/dependent.json`, whole-form reply; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,701 partial records; every completed witness listed by a scratch rerun with the witness cap lifted): 4,499 of 5,479 comparisons agree; differences by kind {"candidate-refuses": 12, "candidate-unknown": 594, "project-refuses": 176, "project-unknown": 186, "value": 12}; on completed returns {"candidate-refuses": 2, "candidate-unknown": 137, "project-unknown": 8, "value": 3} (the reply refuses at dependent.multiple_support on 2; the reply is unknown for dependent.multiple_support, dependent.lawful, dependent.spouse_relative on 137; the project is unknown for dependent.tin, dependent.gross_income, dependent.supported, dependent.age, dependent.kidnapped on 8).
